section_summary.extract_value: This section describes preliminary analyses for a single study examining sex differences across multiple variables related to appearance ideals and behaviors. The authors conducted independent-samples t-tests with Bonferroni correction and found significant sex differences in three areas: women reported higher pressure to conform to media-driven appearance ideals and engaged more in appearance management, while men were more likely to internalize muscular/athletic ideals. Despite null effects for most comparisons, subsequent analyses were conducted separately by sex to account for potential sex-specific effects.
